hypothesis: The causal per-bar near-ATM IV term_slope of the OTHER underlying (cross-asset term-structure spillover) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward downside-semivariance share of the target underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + alignment floor.
extends: EVAL-74 (term_slope signal verbatim) + EVAL-114/122/132/138/139 (cross-asset spillover path verbatim) + EVAL-115 (forward downside-semivariance-share target verbatim) + EVAL-71 (surface floor) + EVAL-77 (cross-asset alignment) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed); distinct cell: cross-asset term_slope spillover -> forward downside semivariance share

protocol.title: Cross-asset near-ATM IV term-structure spillover (other asset's term_slope) -> forward own-asset downside-semivariance share predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)

protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-115 (single-asset atm_iv), EVAL-122/133 (cross-asset term_slope -> skewness/kurtosis) and EVAL-144 (cross-asset term_ratio -> downside); no traded-form claim

cross_section.spillover_signal: signal_k = term_slope[OTHER](k)  (other asset's near-ATM IV near-minus-far slope)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM IV term_slope of the OTHER underlying (e74._term_bars term_slope), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid (build_cross_section), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward downside-semivariance share = mean(min(r-mu,0)**2) / mean((r-mu)**2) over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-115
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_term_slope_z_k, own_dss_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (steeper other-asset near-ATM IV near-minus-far slope -> more downside-concentrated forward variance on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

Below the floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
